notes: A cohort decision-tree model compares postvaccination with prevaccine-era disease burden; CPI inflation adjustment is rescaling, not a procedure. The only sensitivity analysis cited is from a previous study, and there is no uncertainty interval. Coverage inputs come from NIS; the 2023 cohort reuses 2022 data.
view_issues: The Discussion says immunization prevented 'thousands of lifetime illnesses' while results report 508 million. Table 1 gives identical illness and hospitalization counts for diphtheria (7,528).
